reward_gate.threshold_provenance: Thresholds derived from the measured per-arm reward spread on the repaired calibrated substrate (docs/eval/reward_diagnostics.md, 8 workloads x 30 arms, spreads 0.0219-0.1838). MIN_ARM_REWARD_SPREAD sits just below the observed floor of 0.0219; MIN_LIVE_REWARD_SPREAD is half of it because a single episode visits a subset of the candidate axis.

reward_validity.policy: a control cycle whose reward metrics were not yet measured is logged with reward=None and reward_valid=False; the learner receives no update and no fill value is substituted

rule.statement: A regime's trace shows convergence only if it EXPLORED and then EXPLOITED: at least 6 decisions, at least 2 distinct arms in the first half, a second-half modal-arm share of at least 0.75, and a modal share that strictly increased from the first half to the second. A high modal share with no exploration is a learner that never moved, which is the failure the as-published LinUCB already exhibited (200/200 on arm 0) and must not be reported as convergence.

burst.why_not: no exploitation: second-half modal share 0.17 (needs >= 0.75 and > the first half's 0.45)

batch.why_not: no exploitation: second-half modal share 0.40 (needs >= 0.75 and > the first half's 0.40)

interactive.why_not: no exploitation: second-half modal share 0.67 (needs >= 0.75 and > the first half's 0.67)
